subject: [Campus Cat Coalition] You've got a new subscriber!
Twilight needs a loving home
content:
Good morning

I am reaching out for my daughters kitten Twilight. She is less than 1yr
old she has been spayed, she is very calm, sweet and very much loved.

Unfortunately due to my daughter and her husbands busy schedule(s) they are
unable to accommodate Twilight with the time she needs. Love and affection
was never an issue but the pair of them are hardly even home.

Now with both of their jobs are being relocated they have to move into a
place that has a Strict no pet policy. I myself cannot have pets due to
terrible allergies and even with that I’d take her in if my own apartment
didn’t have a no pet policy as well.

If there is any way you could help out and take her in find her a loving
home that can spend time with her or refer us to another agency or place we
would be eternally greatful.


Please let us know as soon as your able as we have no other options. A few
shelters we visited have said they would put her down and that would not be
good for my daughters conscious or mental well being knowing that
Twilight’s fate would be decided in that way due to her career
progressions.

We look forward to speaking with you and or seeing you soon. Thank you soo
much for your time.

subject: Re: Homecoming Countdown Post
content:
Good Morning!
I wanted to follow up with you regarding the collaboration post for homecoming. Please let me know if this is something the Campus Cat Coalition would be interested in by this Friday, October 10th. Otherwise, I will have to pass this opportunity on to another group to meet our deadline. I hope to hear from you soon!

Manhoisiam Tungnung (she/her)
Homecoming Committee Promotions Director
Student Activities
E.H. Hereford University Center
300 W. First Street
Suite B140, Box 19348
Arlington, TX 76019

Email: manhoisiam.tungnung@uta.edu
________________________________
From: Tungnung, Manhoisiam <manhoisiam.tungnung@uta.edu>
Sent: Tuesday, September 30, 2025 3:28 PM
To: utacampuscats@gmail.com <utacampuscats@gmail.com>
Cc: Rivera, Fausto E <fausto.rivera@uta.edu>
Subject: Homecoming Countdown Post

Hello!
My name is Siam Tungnung and I'm the Promotions Director for the Homecoming Committee. As you may or may not know, Homecoming Week is taking place November 9-15th this year with the theme being There's No Place Like Home(coming) inspired by the Oz franchise. With the date approaching soon, our members and I wanted to collaborate with different organizations on campus to put together a 30 day countdown.

The idea is to have different organizations take a picture with their members while counting down to days till homecoming. In your case, we wanted to see if you could feature our campus cats for this post. You and your organization would be responsible for counting down to "1 Day" till homecoming. The post and how you showcase the "1 day" left till homecoming is up to you guys as long as the idea of the countdown is loud and visible. We highly encourage you to proudly showcase your organization and the theme of homecoming. I've also attached pictures below if you need help getting started but totally up to you if you want to change it up.

As for the deadline...I plan on having this post come out in November 8th. I would like to have the pictures sent to me by October 30th (latest by October Oct 31st) to give me enough time to make edits and put the post together. I also ask that the picture be of high quality and sent back through email to preserve its quality. I'm excited to see what your organization comes up with (if you decide to participate!) Thank you for your interest!

With Maverick Pride,
Manhoisiam Tungnung (she/her)
Homecoming Committee Promotions Director
Student Activities
E.H. Hereford University Center
300 W. First Street
Suite B140, Box 19348
Arlington, TX 76019

Email: manhoisiam.tungnung@uta.edu
